description: Solopreneur planning, scoped handoffs, run recovery, and completion reminders. Review exact helper hashes in /hooks.

hooks.command:
python3 -I -c 'import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
for root in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents]:
    path = root / '"'"'.codex/hooks/lifecycle.py'"'"'
    if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
        continue
    data = path.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != '"'"'7e9eda4f25eeb33f15a5ea59d1cccdd39ddb9b93175aed57638df2784e3815b9'"'"':
        continue
    exec(compile(data, str(path), '"'"'exec'"'"'), {'"'"'__name__'"'"': '"'"'__main__'"'"', '"'"'__file__'"'"': str(path)})
    break
'
